name: Monaco
positioning: AI-native revenue engine / all-in-one sales platform for startups (seed–Series A): replaces legacy CRM + point solutions; agents build TAM, run outbound, capture interactions, manage pipeline; white-glove / forward-deployed sales exec onboarding. Domain: monaco.com (NOT monaco.ai, which is a different site).

recent.title: Agent Matrix help-center docs published (seven named agents)
recent.summary: Help article (last updated ~Oct 22) lists ready-made agents by stage: Lookalikes (Target), Re-engagement and Inbound Qualification (Demand), Meeting Prep and Tasks (Close), Pipeline Review and Product Feedback (RevOps). Re-engagement (Monday drafts for quiet email/LinkedIn/meeting threads) and Meeting Prep are on by default for every account; Tasks is a toggle. Custom agents are described in chat, tested on a real deal, and run on schedule or event with approve-first or autonomous mode. Lookalikes and Inbound Qualification are set up with the customer's FDAE (Monaco expert). Connected apps include Notion, Linear, Stripe; Monaco Copilot in Slack. No pricing.

recent.title: Launches Agent Matrix (early access by application)
recent.summary: CEO Sam Blond announced Agent Matrix: goal-seeking agents working together 24/7 to accelerate revenue growth; early access by application (also on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sam-blond-791026b_today-monaco-is-launching-agent-matrix-activity-7518702749442813952-Wmzi). Co-founder Shek Viswanathan (LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7518785430322929666/) says it includes Monaco's own prebuilt agents plus build-your-own (examples: lead routing, inline call/email coaching in Slack, pre-meeting account research), an @monaco Slack bot to create/run/monitor agents, a custom harness with shared memory, outcome tracking and feedback loops, and sales experts in R&D labeling outcomes. Claims 25–35% response rates from re-engaged cold warm leads (company claim; X https://x.com/abishekv/status/2112996547235557782). No product page or pricing as of Oct 22.

recent.title: Acquires Bengaluru sales-intelligence startup Overlayy
recent.summary: FinanceWire Sep 4 (also CIOL Sep 7): Monaco acquires Overlayy (B2B sales conversation intelligence / SalesQA benchmark). Founders Anmol Chaman and Snehil Saluja join Monaco in senior product/engineering roles; terms undisclosed. Overlayy PR: https://overlayy.com/acquisition-pr. Companion: https://www.ciol.com/news/monaco-acquires-bengaluru-sales-ai-startup-overlayy-12501164

recent.title: Homepage: 'first revenue engine for startups' / AI-native platform replacing CRM + point solutions
recent.summary: As of 2026-09-27, monaco.com markets all-in-one revenue platform as system of record: TAM, signals, sequences, pipeline, call recording; agents research accounts, draft outreach, update records. Investor quotes on site from Garry Tan, Peter Thiel, Ryan Petersen.

recent.title: Series B: $50M led by Benchmark (total capital >$85M per coverage)
recent.summary: GlobeNewswire May 12, 2026: Monaco secures $50M Series B led by Benchmark with Founders Fund / Human Capital participation; third-party coverage notes Jack Altman joining board and total funding >$85M. (GlobeNewswire body timed out on re-fetch; date/title/lead confirmed via search + secondary coverage.)

recent.title: Exits stealth / public beta; >$35M raised led by Founders Fund
recent.summary: Launch: public beta of AI-native sales platform for early-stage startups; Series A led by Founders Fund; angels include Collison brothers, Garry Tan, Neil Mehta. Co-founders Sam Blond, Brian Blond, Abishek Viswanathan, Malay Desai. TechCrunch same day: https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/11/former-founders-fund-vc-sam-blond-launches-ai-sales-startup-to-upend-salesforce/
